title: Kenyan Cashew Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew inspired by Kenyan cuisine, with a Chinese twist. This dish combines the richness of cashews with the depth of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and cook until softened.
Add diced sweet potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add stew meat and cook until browned.
Add soy sauce, coconut milk, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in cashews and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
